_comment: Boards the golden fixtures are said on (PLAN-metalstorm-command-language.md §8). Shape: fixture-world.ts FixtureContext. A context is a SUPERSET of the §2 wire payload the LLM receives — it carries region keys (`k`), group ids, sizes and coordinates because those are what the CLIENT holds and what resolution must produce. No `expected` envelope in any fixture may name them: the envelope is names-only, which is design pillar 4 and is asserted by nl-envelope.test.ts.
_keys: `k` is deliberately NOT the slugified display name for every place (see `northgate` vs `north_gate_ridge`) — a resolver that used the display name as the region key would pass if they always agreed.

ambiguous-forces._note: Two squads a partial name fits equally. The strict force rule must ASK, even though 'Chimera Squad' would score identically for both — this is the never-guess-between-armies case.

ambiguous-places._note: Two cities sharing a prefix. A place resolves on outright score dominance, so 'Rand' ties at the prefix tier and asks; 'Randtown' matches exactly and does not.

one-tank-squad._note: Fewer candidates than the sentence asked for — the plan's 'I only have one tank squad' clarification.

no-tanks._note: No candidates at all. Forming a group costs authority and touches AI locks, so this refuses rather than offering to auto-form (§5).

no-defs._note: The client TODAY: the widget context exposes the ui-store but no defs mirror, so there is no way to know which squads are the tank squads. Must refuse with that reason, never fill the first N groups.

no-positions._note: `gp:orgGroups` carries no centroid today, so nearest-to-target is unavailable and ranking falls through idle → largest → id. A missing tie-break must never widen the candidate set.

empty._note: Nothing named at all — every place reference must refuse, never fuzzy-match into the void.
